say:1:1123654001:1.text: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.
say:1:1123654001:1.source_cn: 谢天谢地，还好没把哨子弄丢。\n也多谢你了。
say:1:1123654001:1.male: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.
say:1:1123654001:1.female: Thank goodness! I thought I lost my whistle. Thank you.

say:3:1123654002:1.text: Sorry for being late! These baby terrabirds are such a handful.
say:3:1123654002:1.source_cn: ——我来晚了！真是不好意思，都怪这群小陆行鸟太闹腾了。

say:4:1123654003:1.text: Please be rest assured. They're all in tip-top shape. We raised them with utmost care!
say:4:1123654003:1.source_cn: 不过你也放心，这些鸟崽子都是我们黑嚎氏族精心饲养的，保...

say:5:1123654004:1.text: But you kept me waiting for a long time. Surely, we can renegotiate the price, right?
say:5:1123654004:1.source_cn: 但你耽误了我这么久的时间——价格总还有得商量吧？

say:6:1123654005:1.text: What? Didn't we already agree on the price?
say:6:1123654005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！价格不是早就谈好了吗？！
